title: Components that aren't in the storyboard are still linked from the documentation
body:
**Bug: What is the current behavior?**

All components have a link to "show in storyboard", which links to the storyboard without a selected component

**Bug: What is the expected behavior?**

Components that aren't featured in the storyboard don't have a "view in storyboard" link

**Bug: What browsers are impacted? Which versions?**

All

**What project are you opening an issue for?**
- react-instantsearch

comments.body:
That's tricky because some widgets are actually illustrated through other stories (Highlight, Panel, Snippet...).

Several options:

1. We don't illustrate them through other stories but in their own kind or we duplicate.
2. We add some specific code when generating the doc (not fan).
I am sorry I fail at understanding exactly the issue, do we have bad links somewhere? If so please provide a bad link so I get it :D
[panel](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/react/widgets/Panel.html) for example doesn't have a dedicated story

> We don't illustrate them through other stories but in their own kind

Way to go for me.

The only problem is that that link goes to the storyboard at the first story, because `selectedKind=Panel` doesn't exist.

However probably this isn't really a big deal.

url: `https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/react/storybook/?selectedKind=Panel&selectedStory=default`
Alright, so let's create move some stories inside their own kind.

React InstantSearch has been moved here: https://github.com/algolia/react-instantsearch
This issue has either been rewritten or placed inside our backlog.
